big_case.notes: Routine pro se emergency stay application arising from personal/entity Chapter 7 bankruptcy litigation in E.D. Va. and an unpublished Fourth Circuit mandamus denial of a judicial-recusal motion (No. 26-2404), summarily denied in chambers by the Chief Justice without a response request, referral, amicus filings, or broader legal reach.
